sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next official repository and release news
sources.evidence: Identifies developer, multimodal MoE architecture, open weights, and an explicit August 26, 2026 release announcement. Documents Gated DeltaNet plus Qwen Sparse Attention, gated residuals, n-gram embedding, and deployment with tool-call parsers.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next official model card
sources.evidence: Reports nominal 125B main language model with 6B active, plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP; causal language model with vision encoder. Explicitly maps hosted Qwen3.8-Flash to this checkpoint with additional production features, including default 1M context.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Fetched directly after browser extraction failed. Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration; 48 text layers, three linear-attention layers per sparse/full-attention layer; 512 experts, 10 selected plus a shared expert; vision configuration, native 262144 positions, one MTP layer, and no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Official BF16 checkpoint index and indexed safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read headers only from all 131 indexed shards. All 1658 tensor names matched the index. Counted 179999981424 BF16 weight elements and excluded 35 I64 n-gram indexing elements (layer_multipliers, ngram_heads_offsets, ngram_heads_vocab_sizes). Unique BF16 partitions: main 125710814080, n-gram path 51233085440, MTP 2607150848, vision 448931056. No packed quantization or scale tensors counted.

sources.title: Hugging Face official repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository revision de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540. Safetensors metadata independently matches BF16=179999981424 and I64=35. Repository creation August 24 and last modification August 27 are metadata dates, not evidence of public launch.

sources.title: Qwen Community License 1.0
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint includes Qwen Community License 1.0. It permits weight distribution subject to terms, including separate licensing for commercial Model as a Service or AI Work Assistant businesses.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next official chat template
sources.evidence: Implements text/image/video inputs, configurable thinking with xhigh/medium/low effort, tool definitions, structured function calls, and tool responses.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A New Architecture, Towards Ultimate Cost-Efficiency
sources.evidence: Article dated August 27, 2026, describes the weight release and GDN/QSA MoE architecture. Gives 125B main plus 51B n-gram parameters, 6B activated per token; explains n-gram lookup parameters do not enter the per-token matrix-multiplication budget. Confirms native 262144 context and YaRN extension to 1000000.

name.note: Baseline display spelling corresponds to official Qwen3.8-Flash-Next branding.

developer.note: Repository explicitly attributes development to Qwen Team, Alibaba Group.

family.note: Official Qwen series; Qwen4 architectural preview retains the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model identity.

release_date.note: Explicit official repository release news establishes August 26. August 27 is the later Alibaba Cloud article date; repository creation and modification dates are not launch dates.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable checkpoint is present. Hosted Qwen3.8-Flash is explicitly based on it, but its production context is a distinct setting.

license.note: Exact checkpoint license verified; open weights does not mean unrestricted commercial hosting.

parameters_b.note: Complete BF16 checkpoint count in decimal billions, including vision, n-gram path, and MTP. Excludes 35 integer indexing elements. The card gives nominal component figures; 125B is the main model, not the whole checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Official nominal active language-model count per token. N-gram lookup storage is excluded from the stated matrix-multiplication budget; this is not an independently measured all-modality/MTP execution count.

architecture.note: Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/Qwen Sparse Attention with MoE feed-forward layers, gated residuals, n-gram embeddings, MTP, and a vision encoder.

context_window.note: Native checkpoint context. Optional YaRN extension reaches 1000000; the hosted production default does not replace the native checkpoint value.

modalities.note: Vision encoder and image/video tokens supplement textual input; autoregressive textual responses.

reasoning.note: Official template implements enabled-by-default thinking and selectable effort.

tool_call.note: Official template handles tool definitions, structured calls, and responses; developer deployment examples enable automatic tool parsing.

description.value: Open-weight multimodal MoE preview of Qwen4, combining Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention with a vision encoder, n-gram embeddings, and MTP. The complete BF16 checkpoint contains about 180B parameters; the main language model activates a nominal 6B per token.
description.note: Corrects the misleading 125B total claim and describes verified architecture without unsupported comparative performance claims.

patch.description: Open-weight multimodal MoE preview of Qwen4, combining Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention with a vision encoder, n-gram embeddings, and MTP. The complete BF16 checkpoint contains about 180B parameters; the main language model activates a nominal 6B per token.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint count is 179,999,981,424 BF16 parameters, excluding 35 I64 indexing values. Official nominal 125B main + 51B n-gram + 4B MTP labels are component descriptions, not an exact independent-tensor breakdown. Stored MTP tensors total 2.607150848B and configuration disables dedicated MTP embeddings, so shared tensors are counted once. The nominal 6B active count concerns language-model computation and excludes n-gram lookup storage. Native context is 262144; hosted Qwen3.8-Flash adds a default 1M context. August 26 is the explicit official release date; August 27 is the Cloud article date.

summary: Correct release date to August 26. Fill complete checkpoint parameters at 179.999981424B, nominal active parameters at 6B, and architecture as MoE. The old description wrongly called the 125B main model the total; corrected to about 180B including n-gram, MTP and vision. Confirm other capabilities, native context and exact license; preserve the explicit distinction from hosted Qwen3.8-Flash. All 14 fields have primary evidence.
